jp: \t\t口径はそのままに、火薬を大増量した弾。拳銃でも高い威力を出せるが、反動が大きい。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t口径はそのままに、火薬を大増量した弾。拳銃でも高い威力を出せるが、反動が大きい。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Bullets with the same caliber but with a greatly increased amount of gunpowder. It can be used in handguns with high power, but the recoil is significant. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Bullets with the same caliber but with a greatly increased amount of gunpowder. It can be used in handguns with high power, but the recoil is significant. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un proiettile che, a parità di calibro, porta molta più polvere da sparo. Anche da una pistola tira fuori una gran potenza, ma il contraccolpo è forte. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t高エネルギー体を特殊な技術で銃弾へと加工したもの。使用するには専用の銃器が必要だ。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t高エネルギー体を特殊な技術で銃弾へと加工したもの。使用するには専用の銃器が必要だ。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: High-energy materials are processed into bullets using special technology. A special firearm is required to use them. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "High-energy materials are processed into bullets using special technology. A special firearm is required to use them. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un corpo ad alta energia lavorato in proiettile da una tecnica speciale. Per adoperarlo serve un'arma da fuoco apposita. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t機械弓に用いられる四角い矢じりのついた細い棒状の矢弾。重量はあるが、機械弓に装填できるのはこれのみである。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t機械弓に用いられる四角い矢じりのついた細い棒状の矢弾。重量はあるが、機械弓に装填できるのはこれのみである。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A thin rod-shaped arrowhead with a square arrowhead used in mechanical bows. Although heavy, it is the only one that can be loaded into a mechanical bow. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A thin rod-shaped arrowhead with a square arrowhead used in mechanical bows. Although heavy, it is the only one that can be loaded into a mechanical bow. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un dardo sottile, a forma d'asta, con la punta quadrata, che si adopera nelle balestre. Pesa, ma è l'unica cosa che in una balestra si possa caricare. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t銃から発射される為に加工された小さな玉。これが無ければどれ程高名な銃であろうと、ただの筒でしかない。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t銃から発射される為に加工された小さな玉。これが無ければどれ程高名な銃であろうと、ただの筒でしかない。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Small spheres machined to be fired from a firearm. Without it, a firearm would be nothing but a mere tube, no matter how prestigious the gun may be. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Small spheres machined to be fired from a firearm. Without it, a firearm would be nothing but a mere tube, no matter how prestigious the gun may be. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Una piccola sfera lavorata per essere sparata da un'arma da fuoco. Senza di questa, per quanto famosa sia un'arma, non è che un tubo. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t弓に用いる為の矢を束ねたもの。束ねているので素材によっては非常に重く、携行には注意が必要である。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t弓に用いる為の矢を束ねたもの。束ねているので素材によっては非常に重く、携行には注意が必要である。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A bundle of arrows for use with a bow. Because they are bundled, some materials are very heavy and must be carried with care. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A bundle of arrows for use with a bow. Because they are bundled, some materials are very heavy and must be carried with care. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un fascio di frecce da adoperare con l'arco. Essendo in fascio, a seconda del materiale pesano moltissimo, e a portarsele dietro ci vuole attenzione. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~
